_design: SHAPE-CHANGING RHYTHM (user principle: every gimmick must force a leg-shape change). The required leg cycles SHORT(tunnel) → LONG(gap/planks) → HOOK(steep ramp) → SPIKY(ice) so the player redraws at almost every beat. STAIRS were REMOVED (the kinematic engine can't sell foot-on-tread contact — the leg dangled in the step gaps yet still climbed). Climbs are now STEEP SMOOTH RAMPS (slope ~0.85 >= steepThresh 0.6 ⇒ hook-gated; a smooth/short leg slips at the foot, only a hook grips). ICE is the NEW gimmick: a smooth/hook leg slips in place, only a TOOTHED zigzag (아이젠) grips. balls/blocks/bumps are no-gate TEXTURE breathers between forcing gimmicks. Each steep UP ramp is paired with a DOWN ramp so the vertical profile stays bounded.

segments._note: START lead-in — run straight, draw the first leg.
SHORT — low ceiling; a long leg's sweep strikes it, must draw a short leg.
LONG — leap the V-trench; a short leg drops in and crawls (slow).

STAIRS climb (계단형, restored). 6 treads, riser ~0.57u / run ~1.17u, overall slope 0.49 (< 0.6 ⇒ LENGTH-gated, not hook-gated). With the new physics the leg TIP must land on a TREAD (윗면) to climb step-by-step; a too-short leg can't reach the next riser ⇒ jams (redraw longer). Climb only on the tread face, not the riser side.
recovery DOWN ramp (slope 0.68, descending ⇒ NOT gated).
ICE gimmick REMOVED per user request — was a slippery 'ice' segment; replaced with flat (same length) so the course/finishX is unchanged. Ice engine code kept dormant.

rival._note: BOLT auto-swaps its leg per gimmick (game.js _buildRivalSchedule: short@tunnel, long@gap/planks, hook@steep-ramp, zigzag@ice, long default). pace will be re-tuned by scripts/verify_t01.mjs RACE gates after this course redesign (stairs removed, ice + steep ramps added, course length changed).
